sentences.en: Federal fortresses set at liberty von Beyer's division for field service in the west.

sentences.en: On the 15th and 16th of June Beyer moved on Cassel, while the two other Prussian generals converged on Hanover.
sentences.vi: Vào ngày 15 và 16 tháng 6, Beyer di chuyển trên Cassel, trong khi hai vị tướng khác của Phổ hội tụ về Hanover.

sentences.en: The Hessians retired upon Hanau to join the 8th Federal corps; only the Hanoverians remained in the north, and they too, threatened by Beyer's advance, marched from their point of concentration at GÃ¶ttingen southward for the Main.

sentences.en: Flies's column (backed by a fresh brigade) south of Langensalza, and Beyer approached from Eisenach.

sentences.en: The remainder of the Hesse-Cassel troops, which had retired southward before Beyer's advance on Cassel, went to the Rhine valley about Mainz.
sentences.vi: Phần còn lại của quân Hesse-Cassel, đã rút lui về phía nam trước cuộc tiến công của Beyer trên Cassel, đi đến thung lũng Rhine về Mainz.

sentences.en: I wonder how Massah Beyer has become such an Expert on what they show on these encrypted only channels anyway?
